messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: Aurora reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Main asks: final quota numbers, autoscale guardrails, and renewal-risk thresholds so account execs can prep. Also can we capture a short post-rollout feedback survey from their platform team?
Liam (Aurora): Thanks Priya. Confirming requested quota: start 45k req/s, target steady 55k, burst ceiling 70k. We'll also want an SLA-exception clause for the first 7 days. I'll own feedback survey with our PM.
Noah (SRE): Autoscale & safety suggestions: initial min_replicas=3, target_replicas for 55k ~ 12, max_replicas=24. Scale-up if gpu_util > 82% for 90s; scale-down cooldown 3m. Circuit-breaker: if >4 partial errors per minute for >5m, route 30% traffic to hosted fallback and alert.
Dana (Infra): Addendum: enable pre-warm VMs for 20m on the first ramp and set model-variant fallback to 8-bit quantized model if mem pressure > 75%. Also we need their KMS thumbprint by EOD to attach keys.
Maya - Solutions: I'll assemble a one-pager runbook + 2 curl examples for the customer SREs. Also propose a short survey we can POST to their webhook after the warmup asking 3 questions: SLO met? Any errors? Open feedback?
Priya (CS): Renewal signal note: CS wants the account exec alerted if we hit any of these during rollout: 1) >5% 5xxs over a 10m window, 2) repeated throttles >3 times, or 3) missed latency SLO p95 > 750ms for >15m. Treat as high-priority renewal-risk.
Liam (Aurora): Understood. We'll have a primary and backup contact. Also asking for detailed token-level billing estimate for first month based on expected throughput. Finance has to sign the reserved commit.
Noah (SRE): Loadtest spec (pushed to CI):
```
./rwd-stress --name aurora-prime-01 --qps 15000 --duration 40m --ramp 15m --payload sample-2k
collect: p50,p95,p99,token_rate,gpu_util,oom_events
notify: #cs-alerts @Priya
```
I'll attach dashboard link when queued.
Dana (Infra): Quick perf note: from prior runs, pre-warm reduces p95 by ~110ms and decreases OOM spikes. I'll enable pre-warm and watch temp/oom. If GPU mem pressure hits 78% for 2m, auto-fallback to hosted.
Maya - Solutions: Runbook draft uploaded (internal): https://rwd/internal/runbooks/aurora-priming-v2. Contains rollback steps and curl-based smoke tests. Also added a short survey payload: POST https://aurora.example.com/feedback {slo_met:bool, notes:string} (customer webhook)
deploy-bot: Scheduled: dedicated-pool/aurora -> prime-config v4 at 2024-06-13T09:00:00Z.
Priya (CS): Action items recap: 1) Liam provide final KMS thumbprint & billing contact (Liam) 2) Noah queue loadtest and share dashboard (Noah) 3) Dana enable pre-warm and set fallback thresholds (Dana) 4) Maya publish runbook + survey webhook (Maya). I'll run a 08:30 PT preflight.
Liam (Aurora): KMS thumbprint and finance contact emailed. We'll review the billing estimate this afternoon.
Noah (SRE): Loadtest queued id aurora-prime-01 ETA Wed 09:06 PT. Dashboard: https://metrics/r/aurora/aurora-prime-01
Dana (Infra): Pre-warm toggled; monitoring started. Will escalate on any temp or mem anomalies.
Priya (CS): Thanks team 44d. Please paste any immediate post-run feedback in this thread so I can forward to account execs for renewal notes.
Liam (Aurora): We'll do a short internal retro and send the survey answers to Priya after the 24h observation window.
Maya - Solutions: Also adding a quick checklist for customer enablement: (1) API keys validated, (2) KMS bound, (3) runbook copied, (4) post-run survey endpoint confirmed. Marking done as we progress.
